item.text:
For a non-empty `topic`, `get_relevant_context` uses the graph-layer symbolic index path: it calls `relevant_context()`/`entity_index.search_classes(topic)` to get topic-ranked class/instance matches (no LLM involved), then filters matches by the `TOPIC_RELEVANCE_FLOOR` (0.45), converts surviving hits to `ContextItem` objects via `build_context_item`, and returns up to the clamped limit (1–100) formatted as readable context.  
If nothing clears the threshold, it returns the topic-specific empty-state message (`"No recorded knowledge relevant to \"<topic>\""`).  

Sources: project memory entries **“get_relevant_context: pure-symbolic context retrieval via entity index (topic) or list-all (no topic)”** and **“get_relevant_context: relevance floor (0.45) drops noise hits; topic-aware empty-state is honest”**.
